tests.title: Current release research
tests.prompt: Using current web information, determine the latest stable Ollama release/version available now. Prefer an official Ollama source and give the version plus release/publication date if the source provides one. Cite the exact URL(s) you used. Do not answer from memory.

tests.title: Current technical documentation
tests.prompt: Verify from the CURRENT official Ollama documentation how tool calling works with the local POST /api/chat endpoint. Explain the minimum request structure for defining one function tool and how a tool result is sent back into the conversation. Include a compact JSON example and cite the exact official documentation URL(s). Search and fetch the current documentation; do not rely on remembered syntax.

tests.title: Multi-source current research
tests.prompt: Research the CURRENT minimum NPU TOPS requirement used by Microsoft for a Windows Copilot+ PC. Verify the number using a Microsoft source and at least one additional independent source if available. Explain briefly what that TOPS number refers to and mention any meaningful discrepancy between sources. Cite every URL used.
